# Required for paper triage (filtering for reasoning relevance)                                                                                                                                               
GOOGLE_API_KEY=your-gemini-key                                                                                                                                                                                
                                                                                                                                                                                                                
# Required for summarization (pick one provider)                                                                                                                                                              
OPENAI_API_KEY=your-openai-key                                                                                                                                                                                
# ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=your-anthropic-key                                                                                                                                                                        
# SUMMARY_PROVIDER=anthropic  # openai (default) | anthropic | ollama                                                                                                                                         
                                                                                                                                                                                                                
# Optional                                                                                                                                                                                                    
# OPENAI_MODEL=gpt-4o                                                                                                                                                                                         
# GEMINI_MODEL=gemini-1.5-flash                                                                                                                                                                               
# PROJECTS_DB=data/papers.db                                                                                                                                                                                  
# SUMMARY_BATCH=10                                                                                                                                                                                            
# FLASK_DEBUG=false

{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "target": "ES2020",
    "useDefineForClassFields": true,
    "lib": ["ES2020", "DOM", "DOM.Iterable"],
    "module": "ESNext",
    "skipLibCheck": true,
    "moduleResolution": "bundler",
    "allowImportingTsExtensions": true,
    "resolveJsonModule": true,
    "isolatedModules": true,
    "noEmit": true,
    "jsx": "react-jsx",
    "strict": true,
    "noUnusedLocals": true,
    "noUnusedParameters": true,
    "noFallthroughCasesInSwitch": true,
    "baseUrl": ".",
    "paths": {
      "@/*": ["src/*"]
    }
  },
  "include": ["src"],
  "references": [{ "path": "./tsconfig.node.json" }]
}
